core: Sensory organ and cranial nerve morphogenesis
qualifier: eye, inner ear and cranial ganglia
name: Eye, inner ear and cranial sensory ganglion morphogenesis
rationale: All members are embryonic morphogenesis of cranial sensory structures (eye/retina, cochlea and vestibule, cranial ganglia, taste papillae); eye/retina and trigeminal ganglion members separate it from the olfactory/outer-ear and the hearing-function/lens confusables.

name: Histone pre-mRNA 3'-end processing and Pol II termination
rationale: Members cover stem-loop (SLBP-dependent and independent) 3'-end processing and turnover of histone mRNAs plus Pol II termination, distinct from confusables about mRNA export, capping and splicing.

core: Integrin activation and cell adhesion signaling
name: Rap1-dependent integrin activation and adhesion signaling
rationale: Members concern inside-out integrin activation, integrin-mediated adhesion and its MAPK linkage, with Rap1 signaling distinguishing it from leukocyte extravasation and shear-stress/platelet confusables.

name: RNA polymerase I initiation and rDNA chromatin regulation
rationale: Members are Pol I promoter opening/initiation and chromatin-level activation or silencing of rRNA genes, whereas confusables cover Pol III transcription, Pol I termination/elongation and MYC-driven ribosome biogenesis.

name: Mitochondrial DNA maintenance and mRNA turnover
rationale: Members are mtDNA replication/repair and regulation of mitochondrial mRNA stability and decay, distinct from confusables centred on mitochondrial translation, tRNA processing and transcription.

qualifier: non-canonical NIK pathway and IKK-complex immunodeficiencies
name: Non-canonical NF-kB signaling and IKK-complex immunodeficiencies
rationale: Members are NIK-driven non-canonical NF-kB activation (TNFSF receptors, Dectin-1) and inherited IKK/IkBA defects, unlike confusables about TAK1/NOD/TLR-driven canonical NF-kB and MAPK signaling.

qualifier: DC differentiation and T cell costimulation
name: Dendritic cell differentiation and T cell costimulation
rationale: Members concern dendritic cell differentiation/activation and APC-driven T cell costimulation and proliferation, distinguished from NK/tolerance and regulatory T cell confusables.

name: Ferroptosis regulation and isocitrate-NADPH redox homeostasis
rationale: Members combine ROS detoxification, NADPH regeneration via isocitrate metabolism and pro/anti-ferroptotic control, with ferroptosis and IDH-linked NADPH separating it from ascorbate/aldehyde and NRF2-target confusables.

name: Cilium assembly, transport and motility with centrosome organization
rationale: Members span ciliogenesis, intraflagellar transport, axonemal motility (sperm, airway, ependyma, photoreceptor) and centrosome/microtubule organization, whereas confusables are mitotic spindle, cytokinesis or Hedgehog/PCP signaling.

name: G beta-gamma-coupled phospholipase C, PKC and calcium signaling
rationale: Members are GPCR/RTK-driven PLC-beta and PI3K-gamma activation, IP3/phosphoinositide synthesis, calcium and PKC signaling, distinct from cAMP, BCR and Wnt-calcium confusables.

name: GAG linkage region and chondroitin sulfate biosynthesis disorders
rationale: Members are biosynthesis of the GAG-protein linkage tetrasaccharide and chondroitin/dermatan sulfation with their inherited enzyme defects, distinct from keratan, heparan and dystroglycan glycosylation confusables.

core: Macrophage and microglial proliferation and activation
name: M-CSF-driven macrophage and microglial proliferation and activation
rationale: Members are M-CSF signaling and macrophage proliferation together with microglial proliferation, migration and cytotoxic activation, unlike confusables on microglial differentiation, inhibition or DAP12/CSF1R signaling detail.

name: Dystroglycan O-mannosylation and laminin basement membrane in muscle
rationale: Members cover DAG1 O-mannosyl/matriglycan glycosylation and its dystroglycanopathies, laminin basement membrane assembly and skeletal muscle/NMJ development, distinct from contractile apparatus and other proteoglycan confusables.

name: Osteoclast bone remodeling, mineralization and IGF/phosphate responses
rationale: Members regulate osteoclast differentiation/fusion, bone resorption and mineralization with IGF and FGF23-Klotho phosphate responses, unlike osteoblast/Wnt and tooth mineralization confusables.

name: Na+/K+-ATPase sodium and potassium gradient maintenance
rationale: Members are P-type ATPase sodium export/potassium import, cardiac-glycoside response and intracellular Na+/K+ homeostasis, distinct from renal/magnesium transport and potassium channel confusables.

name: Interferon gamma, lambda and alpha signaling
rationale: Members are type II (IFN-gamma) signaling and its regulation, type III interferon production/response and IFN-alpha response modules, separating it from IL-10/IL-12 family and other cytokine confusables.

name: Keratan sulfate proteoglycan biosynthesis
rationale: All three members concern keratan sulfate synthesis (including its CHST6 defect), distinct from chondroitin/heparan biosynthesis and mucopolysaccharidosis degradation confusables.

name: Urea cycle ornithine-citrulline synthesis and OTC deficiency
rationale: Members are urea cycle arginine/citrulline/ornithine metabolism and OTC variants, distinguished from other urea-cycle enzyme defects and glutamate/ornithine transport confusables.

name: Hepatobiliary bile acid, bilirubin and xenobiotic handling
rationale: Members cover bile acid synthesis/recycling, bilirubin glucuronidation, organic anion transporters and drug ADME with their hereditary defects, unlike intestinal lipid absorption and organic cation transport confusables.

qualifier: cysteine palmitoylation cycle and RAS processing
name: Protein cysteine palmitoylation cycle and RAS C-terminal processing
rationale: Members are protein S-palmitoylation/depalmitoylation, N-terminal lipidation and RAS C-terminal processing, distinct from Wnt/Hedgehog ligand lipidation and RAB geranylgeranylation confusables.

name: NLRP1/NLRP3 inflammasome-mediated IL-1 precursor processing
rationale: Members are NLRP1 and NLRP3 inflammasomes, P2X7 purinergic activation and IL-1 precursor processing, separating it from pyroptosis/CASP4-5/AIM2 and IL-18/IL-17 confusables.

name: Notch, gamma-secretase receptor proteolysis and canonical Wnt signaling
rationale: Members are Notch receptor processing and transcription, other intramembrane-cleaved receptors (ERBB4, p75NTR) and beta-catenin destruction complex signaling with oncogenic mutants; Notch and intramembrane proteolysis distinguish it from the Wnt-only and Hedgehog confusables.

core: Potassium channel control of membrane potential
name: Two-pore and ATP-sensitive potassium channels setting membrane potential
rationale: Members are K2P, KATP (ABCC8/9) and calcium-activated potassium channels regulating resting potential and excitability, distinct from Na+/K+-ATPase and action-potential propagation confusables.

qualifier: ATP/adenosine receptors and KATP channels in ischemia
name: Purinergic ATP/adenosine signaling and KATP channels in ischemia
rationale: Members are P2Y and adenosine receptor signaling, ATP export/hydrolysis, KATP channels and ischemic/gasotransmitter responses, separating it from other GPCR, nitric oxide and calcium signaling confusables.

name: EGFR/ERBB endocytic downregulation and PTEN regulation
rationale: Members are ubiquitin-dependent endocytosis and lysosomal sorting of EGFR/ERBB receptors with PTEN stability/localization control, unlike generic ESCRT and MET/PTK6 signaling confusables.
